title: buildRecordIndex
description: The app's index of a product's space: the record summaries' records by ID, their children and their links both ways, and the domains, with each record's problems (LA-CHK-RM01), its gaps and the coverage (LA-TRC-RM01), the folder tree (LA-EXP-RM02) and the meta model (LA-PLT-RM08) beside them. Built by layer in the space's index worker, each layer when its own reads change and the records worked out again only for what changed since the last answer; the page's mirror puts in only what changed, so the page never parses or builds a large product's lookups whole. The nav, the pages and the stages read it, and it renders nothing.

title: ownerFolders
description: The app's index of the Folder tree read: each owner's stages and folders with their records as summaries, labeled from the meta model, and each record's folded children, looked up once per tree answer and kept while the records and the meta model are the same objects; the nav, the domain and product pages, the group pages, Quick open and the graph's tree read it, and it renders nothing.

title: indexMetaModel
description: The app's index of the Meta model read: each kind by name and in reading order, the stages, the relations' pairs and each table's columns, built once per answer; every page names a kind, places it in its stage, words a link and draws a field from it, and it renders nothing.
